premise: The forest goes to sleep one thing at a time and the moon climbs up to take the night shift so nobody sleeps alone.
inspiration: Goodnight litany (folk lullabies that name each thing in turn); the moon as a kind night-watch so the dark is safe.

en-US.title: Good Night, Forest
en-US.text: [softly] The sun slides down behind the hill. Shhh. The forest is going to sleep. First the flower {flower:fade-out 2s} folds her petals, one, two, three, and tucks her head down. Good night, flower. Then the tree {tree:wobble 0.3} lets his branches hang loose and low. Good night, tree. The mushroom {mushroom:pulse 0.3} pulls her cap down over her ears. Good night, mushroom. {sfx:crickets} The crickets begin their tiny song. Cree, cree, cree. And the owl? [curious] The owl is not sleepy at all. He opens his round eyes, {owl:glow} climbs to the highest branch, and says hello to the moon. {sfx:hoot solo} And the moon climbs up beside him, big and silver, to keep watch. {owl:pulse} [whispers] Nobody in the forest sleeps alone. Not the flower, not the tree, not the mushroom. [yawns] Not you. Good night.

es-ES.title: Buenas noches, bosque
es-ES.text: [softly] El sol se esconde despacio detrás de la colina. Chsss. El bosque se va a dormir. Primero la flor {flower:fade-out 2s} dobla sus pétalos, uno, dos y tres, y agacha la cabeza. Buenas noches, flor. Luego el árbol {tree:wobble 0.3} deja las ramas sueltas y bajitas. Buenas noches, árbol. La seta {mushroom:pulse 0.3} se cala el sombrero hasta las orejas. Buenas noches, seta. {sfx:crickets} Los grillos empiezan su cancioncita. Cri, cri, cri. ¿Y el búho? [curious] El búho no tiene nada de sueño. Abre sus ojos redondos, {owl:glow} sube a la rama más alta y saluda a la luna. {sfx:hoot solo} Y la luna sube a su lado, grande y plateada, para vigilar. {owl:pulse} [whispers] Nadie en el bosque duerme solo. Ni la flor, ni el árbol, ni la seta. [yawns] Ni tú. Buenas noches.

crickets.prompt: soft night crickets chirping in a calm meadow, distant and even

hoot.prompt: a single friendly owl hoot, soft and low, from a nearby tree
